name: md-format-vscode
description: Format Markdown with Prettier plus CJK/Emoji-aware table alignment. Tables stay aligned by visual width (full-width = 2), which Prettier's byte-based alignment gets wrong.

mdFormat.tablesOnly.markdownDescription: Skip Prettier and only align tables (surgical mode). Corresponds to the CLI's `--tables-only`.

mdFormat.delimiterRowNoPadding.markdownDescription: Remove space padding around the delimiter row. Corresponds to `markdown.extension.tableFormatter.delimiterRowNoPadding`.

mdFormat.normalizeIndentation.markdownDescription: Normalize table indentation to whole tab stops. Corresponds to `markdown.extension.tableFormatter.normalizeIndentation`.

mdFormat.tabSize.markdownDescription: Tab size used when `#mdFormat.normalizeIndentation#` is enabled.

mdFormat.hrLength.markdownDescription: Length of standalone thematic breaks (`<hr>`, e.g. `---`). Only applied when Prettier runs (ignored when `#mdFormat.tablesOnly#` is enabled). Corresponds to the CLI's `--hr-length`.

mdFormat.doubleWidthUnicodeRanges.markdownDescription: Unicode ranges (each entry a single char `\uXXXX` or a range `\uXXXX-\uYYYY`) treated as double-width (visual width 2). When non-empty, **replaces** the workspace `mdformat.config.js` value and the built-in defaults for this field.

mdFormat.narrowOverrideUnicodeRanges.markdownDescription: Unicode ranges that `\p{Extended_Pictographic}` misjudges as wide but that actually render half-width (e.g. trademark, info source). When non-empty, **replaces** the workspace `mdformat.config.js` value and the built-in defaults for this field.
